// diagnostic

E0153

protocol `{name}` failed to expand into handle types.

What

protocol `{name}` failed to expand into handle types.

Why

protocol/session types (D-PROTO1): the compiler generates `#SingleUse` `.Client`/`.Server` stubs from the `protocol` block — a generated fragment did not parse.

Fix

check the protocol declaration for typos; if this persists, file a bug.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0153: tests/ui/protocol_out_of_order.stderr.

Error [E0080]: A braced callable with a non-unit success result needs `->` before its body.
  --> tests/ui/protocol_out_of_order.jet:9:21
    |
  9 |     server: Ack(session: Int)
    |                     ^
 Why: the body arrow marks a declared success value; unit and unit-fallible callables keep bare braces.
 Fix: write `fn name(...) Type -> { ... }`; keep `fn name(...) { ... }` and `fn name(...) ! { ... }` bare.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0080
